sources.title: Qwen3.8 27B Uncensored Chat - a Hugging Face Space by MicroHERO
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B Uncensored Chat Multimodal (text + image) chat with Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored (GGUF Q8_0) running on HF ZeroGPU via llama.cpp. Attach an image, ask anything. Note: 29 GB model on the free ZeroGPU tier — the first request after a cold start pays a long load (download + VRAM), and each visitor has a small daily ZeroGPU quota (~5 min). Keep generations short for the best experience ...

sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B Locally | Atomic Chat
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27.8B-parameter multimodal model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released on August 14, 2026. It reads text, images and video, carries a 262,144-token context window, and ships under Apache 2.0, so it can run locally in Atomic Chat without an API key.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored model | NanoGPT
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored is an NVFP4 open-weight multimodal model LoRA-tuned for fewer refusals across chat, coding, reasoning, tool use, and long-context work.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Local: GGUF Quants + llama.cpp
sources.snippet: Run Qwen 3.8 27B uncensored locally: pick the GGUF quant for your VRAM, serve it with llama.cpp or Ollama, and respect the research-only boundary.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored Demo - a Hugging Face Space by quagentris
sources.snippet: This web app lets you talk to the Qwen3.8‑27B uncensored language model. Enter your OrcaRouter API key and type a message, then the model replies with a text answer (and optional reasoning).
